subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal mode as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface core behavior, gateway protocol, UI/channel rendering, and unattended goal continuation semantics; source repair alone cannot decide product scope or rollout shape.

options.title: Split staged PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and ask for separate focused review/proof of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver work.

options.title: Sponsor full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and own the compatibility, proof, and rollout risk of the paired PR as one branch.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can keep only the partial primitives or request a smaller plugin/API design before core adoption.

recommendation.title: Split staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and ask for separate focused review/proof of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history link to the current plan-tool and strict-agentic gating semantics that this roadmap builds on.
